replay_procedure: Keystrokes below are Standard-keyboard codes (s=ㄋ, u=ㄧ, c=ㄏ, l=ㄠ, 3=third tone): 'sucl' parses to ni+hao, the same syllables the pinyin corpus queries as 'nihao'.
A case may specify either input (a literal string) or repeat {unit, times}; the effective input is unit repeated times times. Both drivers must resolve it identically.

For every case: open a fresh zhuyin facade over fixtures/w3 (no user dir). Scheme values are C discriminants (chewing 1 Standard 2 Hsu 3 Ibm 4 Ginyieh 5 Eten 6 Eten26 8 HsuDvorak 9 DachenCp26; 7 StandardDvorak is unimplemented; full 1 Hanyu 2 Luoma 3 SecondaryZhuyin) and must fit in a byte.
1. If chewing_scheme/full_scheme is set: apply it. A rejection records scheme_error and ends the case.
2. If probe_chewing/probe_full is set: run the one-key probe; record the key object (initial, middle, final, tone, packed, zhuyin, pinyin) or null.
3. If in_keyboard is set: record the mapped symbol list; a multi-character key records in_keyboard_error instead.

4. parse(input) in mode (chewing default, full for full pinyin): batch-parse, guess the after-cursor window at 0, record mode/consumed/input/parsed_len/composing/ran and the full snapshot (text, kind, candidate_type, consumed_bytes, cost, nbest_index).
8. For every index in select: choose that snapshot row; record index/cursor/composition_offset/composing/first 8 snapshot texts. On error record select_error and stop.
9. If clear is set: clear the constraint at that original-coordinate offset; record offset/cleared/first 8 snapshot texts.
10. If commit is true: commit and record the text.
7. If guess {offset, before} is set: rebuild the window there; record offset/before/ran and the snapshot.
8. For every index in select: choose that snapshot row; record index/cursor/composition_offset/composing/first 8 snapshot texts. On error record select_error and stop.
9. If commit is true: commit and record the text.
A transcript event records exactly what the API returned at that step; on both sides (Rust zhuyin-dump binary and Python binding) the steps are identical and deterministic.
